data.title: Add configurable bug templates
data.body:
## Goal

Allow custom templates for bug bodies instead of the hardcoded default.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Support template configuration in `.docket/config.toml`
- [ ] Templates stored in `.docket/templates/` directory
- [ ] `docket init` creates a default template
- [ ] `docket new --template NAME` uses named template
- [ ] Default template configurable: `[templates] default = "feature"`
- [ ] Template variables: `{{title}}`, `{{date}}`, `{{id}}`
- [ ] Multiple templates: feature, bugfix, chore, spike, etc.

## Context

The current default template (Goal, Acceptance Criteria, Context, Log) is reasonable but not always appropriate. Different types of work benefit from different structures:

- **Feature**: Goal, User Story, Acceptance Criteria, Design Notes
- **Bugfix**: Problem, Steps to Reproduce, Expected vs Actual, Root Cause
- **Spike**: Question, Time Box, Findings, Recommendation
